scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @hub/api" "npm run dev -w @hub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hub/shared && npm run build -w @hub/api && npm run build -w @hub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hub/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hub/api && npm run typecheck -w @hub/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @hub/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
